messages:
amy.sales: POC kickoff for BetaFin. They need logs+traces to Splunk HEC and want a short demo. They hit 502s when we pushed batched events. Need quick remediation steps + minimal config. @raj.engineer @tess.sre

raj.engineer: Short fixes: lower batch_size, shorten batch_interval, enable trace headers (X-Redwood-Trace & X-Request-ID), and turn on preserve_client_timestamps. Ask for their HEC URL and token.

amy.sales: URL: https://hec.betafin.internal:8088/services/collector, token provided. 502s happened during a bulk replay.

tess.sre: 502 likely their collector rejecting large payloads or MTLS mismatch. For demo: set batch_size=25, batch_interval_ms=250, sample_rate=1.0. If TLS fails, try curl test and ask for cert chain. I'll also add org burst for the demo window.

raj.engineer: Minimal drain snippet to paste: `type=http_hec url=https://hec.betafin.internal:8088/services/collector auth=token:<TOKEN> batch_size=25 batch_interval_ms=250 preserve_client_timestamps=true headers={X-Redwood-Trace:{{trace_id}},X-Request-ID:{{request_id}}} always_send_levels=[error] sample_rate=1.0`

zoe.security: Security note: token-only HEC ok for demo. If they want IP allowlisting later, we provide Redwood outbound CIDRs. Confirm no PII in forwarded payloads or add redaction rules.

amy.sales: They asked to only forward errors + 5% sample after demo. Is that supported?

raj.engineer: Yes. After demo set sample_rate=0.05 and always_send_levels include error/critical.

tess.sre: I'll schedule a 15m smoke test 30m before demo and post a runbook. obs-bot will log runbook id.

obs-bot: observability-bot: Runbook created for BetaFin POC (rb_betafin_hec_01), smoke test scheduled at 2026-04-05T14:30Z

amy.sales: Perfect — I'll send the drain snippet and curl check to their infra and coordinate the smoke test. Thanks everyone :rocket:
